title: Game
description: One record per game. Provides context for all foul events.

home_team_tricode.description: Three-letter code for the home team (e.g. 'MIN').

away_team_tricode.description: Three-letter code for the away team (e.g. 'DEN').

playoff_round.description: Playoff round derived from game_id prefix. e.g. 'first_round', 'conference_semifinals'. Null for regular season games.
